**Overview**  
We're a growing general contractor with about 5 active jobs. This role works directly with the owner and touches every part of the business — project documents, subcontractor compliance, permits, scheduling, client communication, and whatever else comes up that day. It's a practical, hands-on position with real responsibility and room to grow, and no two days look the same.

This starts as a part-time role with a clear path to full-time as the company grows. We're looking for someone who wants to build something here, not just fill hours.

We need someone comfortable with a flexible schedule. Construction is unpredictable, and sometimes things come up after hours or on weekends. We don't expect you to be on call 24/7, but we need someone who picks up when it matters.

Spanish/English — you'll communicate with subs, vendors, and crew members in both languages.

* Handle phones, email, and day-to-day questions from vendors and clients
* Track subcontractor COIs, W-9s, and vendor insurance files; flag anything expiring
* Prepare, distribute, and log change orders; confirm owner sign-off before work proceeds

* Solicit bids from subcontractors, track responses, and organize incoming proposals

* Help organize and improve our file structures and tracking systems
